items.title: Clay Jenkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 18, 2016
items.q: records with jazz artists such as Gene Bertoncini, Kim Richmond and Joe LaBarbera

ctx.x: Clay Jenkins has fashioned a successful career as a jazz performer and educator. Clay has been a member of bands led by Stan Kenton, Count Basie and Buddy Rich and currently plays in the trumpet section of the Clayton- Hamilton Jazz Orchestra. In 2000 he joined the faculty of the Eastman School of Music Jazz Department. Clay maintains a robust performing schedule and records with jazz artists such as Gene Bertoncini, Kim Richmond and Joe LaBarbera.
Clay was interviewed at Hamilton College on March 18, 2016 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
